name: catalysis
description: Catalysis topic vocabulary for Topic A/B/C and Related topics. Facets: reaction (what is catalyzed), material (catalyst class), method (characterization/computation/analysis), system (device, reactor, application). Synonyms: acronyms (all caps/digits, <= 7 chars) match case-sensitively with an optional plural s; phrases match case-insensitively, spaces and hyphens interchangeable; 're:' marks a regular expression. weight < 1 marks broad terms so they rank below specific ones.
